root_cause.historical_token_id_classification: English function words (and, the, in, at) leaked into maritime_token_ids via multi-word phrases (e.g. 'search and rescue' -> 'and'), artificially inflating historical scores to ~80-86% on only 344 tokens, while Byte-Level BPE space-prefixed tokens (Ġcargo, Ġvessel) failed to match standalone IDs.
root_cause.regex_span_matching_regression: Commit a9c9bfb introduced regex boundary matching across all 335 Stage 10 terms without stopword filtering, causing massive dilution (1,652 tokens matched) and regressing maritime accuracy to general English baseline.
root_cause.commit_5680cfe_reversion: Reverting to legacy token-ID lookup recovered historical scores merely by restoring stopword leakage and BPE space mismatch.

applied_fix.build_vocabulary_token_sets: EXCLUDED_STOPWORDS strictly filters function words; leading-space variations (Ġ) included for BPE/SentencePiece tokenizers.
applied_fix.whole_word_consistency: word_ids() boundaries propagate domain and rare status across all constituent subword pieces of intact words; zero sibling leakage or index mismatch.
applied_fix.strict_word_evaluation: Multi-piece words require 100% of constituent subwords to be correctly predicted for top-1 credit.
